newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Summit Care upgraded to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Summit Care upgraded to buy.

text.p: -- ABN AMRO Chicago Corp said Tuesday it upgraded Summit Care Corp to buy from hold and established a price target of $15 a share in the coming months.

-- ABN AMRO Chicago said Summit Care's shares are selling at a discount to book value and considerably below the peer group average. Additionally, an increase in the Texas Medicaid rate is giving ABN AMRO Chicago more confidence about near-term estimates for Summit Care of $0.21 a share for the third quarter ending March 31 and $0.87 for fiscal 1997.
-- Accelerating consolidation also suggests a high likelyhood of Summit Care being bought out in the next 18 months, ABN AMRO said.
-- Summit Care provides long-term care services.
-- Its shares were trading down 1/8 Tuesday at 10-7/8.
